topics.name: Speech enhancement and source separation
topics.summary: The papers use diffusion, flow matching, beamforming, EEG conditioning, and acoustic-semantic cues to recover speech or music from interference. Evaluations emphasize robustness across noise, speakers, trials, and clinical speech conditions.

topics.name: Automatic speech recognition and low-resource speech
topics.summary: The studies improve recognition and pronunciation analysis through multilingual pretraining, alignment supervision, compact self-supervised features, and phoneme-level diagnostics. Datasets and experiments focus on under-resourced languages, atypical speech, streaming inputs, and child assessment.

topics.name: Audio generation and spatial audio
topics.summary: These works study real-time music and speech generation, spatial reproduction, historical instrument digitization, and multichannel coding. Streaming distillation, perceptual testing, acoustic measurement, and cross-modal prediction recur as ways to preserve timing and listening quality.

topics.name: LLM reasoning and process verification
topics.summary: The papers improve language-model reasoning with strategy guidance, policy distillation, executable trace checking, generated environments, and structured benchmarks. Results emphasize rollout reliability, transfer across tasks, and the difference between locally plausible steps and complete solutions.

topics.name: Mechanistic interpretability and model behavior
topics.summary: These studies inspect circuits, gradients, attention, hidden states, and internal memory to explain errors, exposure, sycophancy, and controllability. Causal probes and intervention-based tests reveal useful internal signals while showing that diagnosis does not automatically yield reliable control.

topics.name: Language-model safety evaluation and red teaming
topics.summary: The systems build adversarial prompts, multimodal attack sets, toxicity searches, hallucination tests, and alignment benchmarks to expose unsafe behavior. Cross-model transfer, judge agreement, latent signals, and finite-budget search are used to make failures more measurable.

topics.name: Agent memory and self-improvement
topics.summary: These papers study persistent memory, execution traces, self-distillation, reusable skills, and autonomous research loops. They find that retrieval policy, verification, data freshness, and memory curation strongly affect whether experience improves later behavior or reinforces mistakes.

topics.name: Efficient LLM inference and serving
topics.summary: The methods reduce memory, latency, or token cost through cache quantization, semantic retention, token pruning, sparse verification, speculative generation, and request-level reuse. Experiments show that selective computation can preserve quality while enabling longer contexts and interactive multimodal workloads.

topics.name: Continual learning and knowledge editing
topics.summary: These studies examine selective unlearning, model merging, plasticity, task adaptation, and whether behavioral forgetting reflects changed internal knowledge. Curvature-aware updates, memory-aware training, and explicit capability tests aim to limit collateral degradation.

topics.name: Multilingual NLP resources and text processing
topics.summary: The contributions provide treebanks, morphological resources, dictionary structure, OCR studies, tokenization measurements, and lightweight models for diverse languages. Annotation design, language-aware normalization, and compression-based representations support parsing and robust low-resource evaluation.

topics.name: Information extraction and document intelligence
topics.summary: Document systems combine OCR or visual grounding, confidence signals, structured decoding, retrieval, and human verification. The recurring goal is selective automation for field extraction, fact checking, schema search, product attributes, and complex workplace documents.

topics.name: Recommender systems and user modeling
topics.summary: The papers personalize search, generation, stress sensing, and product information by modeling attributes, preferences, behavior, and sparse user histories. Adaptive questioning and foundation-model embeddings improve relevance, efficiency, and coverage of low-activity users.

topics.name: Fairness and human-centered AI
topics.summary: Audits and organizational studies measure gender representation, team diversity, disclosure, firm risk, collaborative mediation, and well-being goals. The findings connect technical outputs with participation, accountability, social context, and longer-term human effects.

topics.name: Agentic software engineering and evaluation
topics.summary: These works evaluate coding and analysis agents through repository-scale measurement, scientific benchmark reproduction, GUI rewards, fault localization, test generation, and user satisfaction. Structured diagnostics expose reliability, cost, and generalization issues hidden by single success scores.

topics.name: Security and governance of agentic systems
topics.summary: The papers analyze shared memory, provenance, credential exposure, secure code generation, attacker persistence, and execution-risk monitoring. Architectural permissions and trajectory-aware defenses are presented as complements to model-level refusal or detection.

topics.name: Generative image and video models
topics.summary: Controllable visual synthesis uses adaptive guidance, geometric editing, user-centered interfaces, staged generation, and diffusion-based refinement. Benchmarks and applications cover image editing, character consistency, scientific imagery, short-form video, and prompt-structure preservation.

topics.name: 3D generation and scene reconstruction
topics.summary: The methods produce reusable geometry from satellite images, portraits, RGB-D video, point clouds, and text or video prompts. Gaussian splatting, multi-view consistency, sparse representations, and reconstruction-based validation recur across urban, vehicle, avatar, and general scene assets.

topics.name: Vision-language reasoning and spatial grounding
topics.summary: Multimodal models are trained or tested on visual evidence, pointing gestures, physical constraints, search behavior, and contextual scene understanding. Spatial supervision, temporal checks, and grounded rewards improve explanations while revealing persistent shortcut use.

topics.name: Video understanding and temporal perception
topics.summary: The studies use frame retrieval, temporal anchors, semantic rewards, tracklet memory, and multi-frame datasets for streaming video interpretation. They target missed evidence, identity drift, event localization, and reasoning over long or egocentric recordings.

topics.name: Visual perception and segmentation
topics.summary: Robust visual recognition combines multispectral fusion, sensor co-design, equivariant distillation, event cues, few-shot prototypes, and geometry-aware masks. Benchmarks span restoration, head pose, open-vocabulary segmentation, stereo, anomaly detection, and dense matching.

topics.name: Remote sensing and geospatial machine learning
topics.summary: Satellite and aerial systems combine optical, radar, temporal, and auxiliary data for flood, cyclone, soil-moisture, crop, air-quality, and mapping tasks. Self-supervision, material-aware fusion, noisy labels, and human-aligned quality measures improve transfer to real environmental observations.

topics.name: Medical imaging and clinical vision
topics.summary: Clinical vision systems address MRI synthesis, CT reconstruction, retinal and pulmonary analysis, lesion localization, biomedical adaptation, and longitudinal radiology reporting. Anatomical structure, realistic perturbations, uncertainty, and evidence-aware evaluation improve clinical usefulness and auditability.

topics.name: Clinical NLP and health decision support
topics.summary: The work combines structured medical knowledge, multilingual retrieval, multimodal benchmarks, specialist reasoning, physiological reporting, and uncertainty-aware recommendations. Repeated findings concern evidence traceability, language transfer, calibration, and the need for clinician oversight.

topics.name: Robot imitation and vision-language-action learning
topics.summary: Robot policies learn from cross-embodiment demonstrations, synthetic videos, geometric waypoints, affordance transfer, and retry-aware value signals. The methods seek reusable skills while preserving spatial structure and improving behavior under imperfect demonstrations.

topics.name: Embodied navigation and world models
topics.summary: Navigation systems combine scene memory, learned dynamics, counterfactual video, semantic maps, fixed-camera views, and long-horizon retrieval. Experiments cover indoor robots, driving, agriculture, maritime settings, and microrobots, with gains tied to foresight and complementary observations.

topics.name: Robot manipulation and contact perception
topics.summary: Manipulation systems infer contact, slip, pose, and object structure from vision, proprioception, tactile exploration, and compliant mechanisms. Simulation-in-the-loop refinement and fault-aware control support reliable handling of deformable objects and uncertain contacts.

topics.name: Multi-robot coordination and autonomous mobility
topics.summary: The studies coordinate vehicles, robot teams, UAVs, and distributed agents using intent sharing, local search, consensus, probabilistic prediction, and communication-aware planning. Results emphasize reduced coordination cost, safer interaction, and scalable specialization.

topics.name: Reinforcement learning algorithms and theory
topics.summary: These papers develop actor-critic guarantees, multi-task and multi-agent transfer, latent action guidance, future-information planning, and automated curricula. The recurring concerns are finite-sample behavior, constraint handling, transferability, and exploration under sparse feedback.

topics.name: Optimal control and trajectory planning
topics.summary: Constrained planners combine differentiable MPC, parallel Riccati or dynamic programming updates, model-based search, and predictive motion tracking. Applications include ground vehicles, humanoids, legged robots, UAVs, and mechanisms where real-time feasibility matters.

topics.name: Physics-informed learning and dynamical systems
topics.summary: The methods learn differential equations, neural operators, phase fields, fluid surrogates, chaotic inverses, and biological propagation while enforcing or auditing physical structure. Bayesian sharing, spectral bases, conservation tests, and certified horizons expose when low residual error still hides incorrect dynamics.

topics.name: Time-series forecasting and uncertainty
topics.summary: Forecasting studies address regime changes, disease progression, financial context, energy deployment, event streams, and delayed adaptation. Probabilistic scoring, continual updates, conformal or analytic uncertainty, and decision-aware certification are favored over single aggregate accuracy.

topics.name: Graph learning and network analysis
topics.summary: Graph methods study spectral recovery, adaptive filters, federated long-tail learning, influence coverage, heterophily, pollution prediction, and dynamic connectivity. Sampling, learned couplings, and structural statistics improve recovery when observations or relationships are sparse and uneven.

topics.name: Optimization and combinatorial search
topics.summary: The contributions use decision diagrams, bifurcation schedules, learned graph sparsification, stochastic-gradient analysis, sharpness certificates, and asymmetric value calculations. Each exploits problem structure to reduce expensive search while controlling approximation or statistical error.

topics.name: Wireless, IoT, and edge machine learning
topics.summary: These systems optimize wireless policies, batteryless execution, distributed training, rainfall prediction, energy-aware infrastructure, and neuromorphic signal recognition. Adaptation, compression, synchronization, and hardware-aware scheduling repeatedly determine deployment viability.

topics.name: Fault detection and cyber-physical monitoring
topics.summary: Operational diagnosis combines lightweight transformers, physics-informed inverse models, transfer learning, reliability benchmarks, and hybrid temporal detectors. Applications include turbines, bearings, power protection, renewable grids, and intrusion monitoring under limited or shifted data.

topics.name: Representation learning and knowledge distillation
topics.summary: The studies organize features through equivariance, latent-space transformations, sparse concept bottlenecks, gradient-aware distillation, and block-structured visual codes. Their results connect compact representations with transfer, interpretability, and task-specific efficiency.

topics.name: Robustness under distribution shift
topics.summary: Benchmarks and adaptation methods test changes in domains, sensors, subjects, queries, protocols, and generators. OOD scoring, test-time updates, leakage controls, and realistic subgroup splits show that average in-domain performance often overstates deployment reliability.

topics.name: Causal inference and counterfactual reasoning
topics.summary: The papers use structural models, actual-causality analysis, intervention geometry, counterfactual image tests, and language-prior audits to distinguish explanation from plausibility. Applications span cyber-physical failures, generative models, geological inversion, and decision support.

topics.name: Privacy-preserving machine learning
topics.summary: Privacy methods protect model inputs, identifiers, retrieval contexts, and enterprise records using homomorphic computation, semantic rewriting, masking, and synthetic data. Evaluations balance confidentiality against accuracy, reconciliation, and downstream control-testing utility.

topics.name: Molecular and chemical machine learning
topics.summary: Chemical systems model solvent effects, peptide geometry, uncertainty-aware search, and petroleum-domain adaptation. Geometry-aware latent spaces and calibrated exploration are used to improve transfer beyond narrowly sampled molecular conditions.

topics.name: Accessibility and augmented reality collaboration
topics.summary: Assistive and collaborative interfaces combine multimodal agents, low-vision browsing, AAC design, situated AR, and occlusion-aware content placement. User studies and expert cases emphasize autonomy, workload, legibility, and preserving access to physical targets.

topics.name: Human behavior and social computing
topics.summary: These studies model expertise, mental-health simulation, cognitive workload, and social interaction through workflow traces, event-based sensing, and conversational or virtual environments. They emphasize contextual variation and the limits of reducing human experience to a single score.

topics.name: Ontology engineering and knowledge representation
topics.summary: Formal knowledge systems address defeasible query answering, permissions and duties, verification of competency questions, and structured discovery of quantum codes. Explicit semantics and rule-based abstractions reduce ambiguity before downstream querying or reasoning.

topics.name: Image restoration and signal reconstruction
topics.summary: The methods reconstruct images or signals using unfolding, learned priors, flow-based restoration, spectral processing, and artifact-aware filtering. Applications span compressive video, texture transfer, ultrasound, and other settings where measurements are incomplete or corrupted.

topics.name: Imbalanced classification and biometric verification
topics.summary: Task-specific losses and quality-controlled synthetic sampling address skewed classes and noisy minority examples. Biometric and general classification experiments show that neighborhood-aware data filtering can improve rare-class behavior beyond generic oversampling.

topics.name: Scientific and visual analytics tools
topics.summary: These contributions build interactive analysis, residual diagnostics, supply-chain simulation, civic storytelling, and speculative visualization tools. They combine structured visual encodings with domain workflows to support exploration, comparison, and communication rather than prediction alone.
